text:
[LFST.2.1] The runtime delivers events as **typed in-memory
values** through the registered stream callback. The
encoding the integrator uses to capture those values
to disk, send them across processes, or feed them
into a replay engine is the integrator's choice. The
spec commits to the *content* — the envelope fields,
the event-kind taxonomy, the sequencing invariants —
not to a wire format.
